reference_spec.heading_separation_definition: signed wrap(base_Link COM XY velocity course minus each retargeted wheel rolling-plane heading)
reference_spec.wheel_heading_definition: world(local +Y wheel axle) crossed with world +Z; independent of axle spin

motion_contract.positions: world Z-up meters, link origins rather than COM
motion_contract.linear_velocities: world-frame original unmerged URDF link COM velocities, m/s
motion_contract.runtime_model_note: Export-model hashes document kinematic provenance, not an actuator/contact contract; apply and audit the shared validation model settings separately.

task_profile.description: New matched-backend native400Hz training cohort; action-rate weight -0.5, original last-substep grounded reward +0.4, free absolute height, shared mjlab-style DR. Training is from scratch; no historical checkpoint initializes either arm.

base_objective_contract.sideslip_target: held reference body-frame course angle, NOT zero
base_objective_contract.reference_order: Freeze reference[k] and relative-body targets at pre-action state; evaluate after decimation, before command advances.
base_objective_contract.pose_semantics: World link-origin position and link wxyz quaternion
base_objective_contract.velocity_semantics: World original-unmerged-link COM linear velocity and world angular velocity
base_objective_contract.cost: dt * (sum_positive_reward_weights - sum(weight * raw_term)); no terminal term supplied
surrogate_differences: MuJoCo net contact forces are not identical to PhysX ContactSensor forces; all contacts, including self-contact, are included.
undesired_contacts uses max norm over supplied physical-substep history; omitted history is explicitly an instantaneous surrogate.
MuJoCo-derived 0.95 joint ranges are an approximation unless replaced by Isaac runtime soft_joint_pos_limits in matching joint order.
Body COM offsets/inertias must match the original unmerged USD links; random COM offsets require the same realized model parameters.
Task tilt safety termination and policy action/observation privileges are outside this stage objective.

ground_contact_reward_v2.force_input: ground-filtered upward world-Z normal force N; [...,8,2]
ground_contact_reward_v2.mass_normalization: mg is actual post-DR total mass times gravity magnitude in N
ground_contact_reward_v2.support_requirement: At least one supporting wheel; single-wheel lift or alternating load is allowed
ground_contact_reward_v2.only_causal_change: I plus bounded loaded-contact physical-step angularXY increment cost
ground_contact_reward_v2.angular_velocity_source_units: world rad/s; increment per actual2.5ms physics step

ground_force_kind: floor-only NORMAL world force acting on each wheel
ground_count_semantics: floor pair normal force >=1e-6N; not legacy>5N
discounted_objective: sum_h gamma**h * dt * (reward_upper_bound - total_stage_reward); fixed horizon, no terminal value

plant_contact_material_audit.mapping: explicit wheel priority1 / other colliders0; all colliding sliding mu equal target; not mu squared

native_plant_readback.source: compiled native MuJoCo MjModel arrays after declared configuration
native_plant_readback.inertia_convention: body_inertia principal moments; body_ipos/body_iquat define local inertial frame

prediction_contact_material_audit.mapping: explicit wheel priority1 / other colliders0; all colliding sliding mu equal target; not mu squared

prediction_state_contract.algorithmic_memory: Physical-substep contact-force history plus first-reward reset flag; not extra robot state or actuators.
prediction_state_contract.excluded_integration_state: qacc warm-start and simulator time are cold-reset per prediction interval; no actuator activation state exists in this model.
prediction_state_contract.external_applied_forces: Required zero in both predictor and plant; no prescribed root correction.

prediction_reset_caveat: Predictor cold-resets solver warmstart/time each20ms stage; validation plant integrates continuously. Full hidden-contact-state equivalence is NOT claimed even within MuJoCo.
state_access: Full qpos/qvel, objective memory and future reference; PPO actor has a51dim observation
PPO_total_reward_unavailable_reason: Saved PPO traces lack all-body contact force/history; do not manufacture an exact episode-return comparison.
reward_parity_scope: NEW grounded replacement; fourteen other legacy stage terms unchanged. Not the old PPO trained reward and not bitwise cross-engine force parity.
timing_caveat: End-to-end measured solve time includes IPC; no realtime or hardware-matched PPO inference claim.

action_parameterization.baseline: Winning bounded initial FULL plan, or bounded fallback when all initial scores fail; fresh after each warm shift
action_parameterization.zero_residual: Exactly represents the initial baseline, not a later improved incumbent
action_parameterization.incumbent: Paired stored best encoded residual and decoded full plan
action_parameterization.elite_moments: Encoded clipped residual parameters; never re-compress decoded/clipped actions
action_parameterization.finite_validation: Before residual encoding clip, before decoded action clip, and for elite moment arithmetic; invalid arithmetic raises
action_parameterization.generic_bounds: New mode rejects nonfinite spans and rounded spans failing endpoint saturation; decoded sums must still be finite
